en.title: Golden Heartbeat and the Market of Forgotten Gears
en.premise: In an era where warmth returns to the world and new life begins to bloom, Leon—endowed with a golden heart—travels alongside Clara and Type Zero in search of fragments of lost technology. However, a strange malady known as "Memory Loss" begins to plague the people, eroding their very minds. The cause is revealed to be the "Memory Market," a place where memories are converted into physical gears and traded as commodities. Realizing that his own golden heartbeat is the key to awakening the records of a lost past, Leon plunges into the abyss of the Mist City.

zh.title: 黄金脉动与遗忘的齿轮市场
zh.premise: 这是一个世界重获温暖、新生命开始萌芽的时代。拥有黄金心脏的雷昂与克拉拉、零式一同踏上了寻找失落技术碎片的旅程。然而，一种名为“记忆缺失”的怪病正在蔓延，侵蚀着人们的精神。人们发现，这一切的根源竟在于“记忆交易市场”——一个将记忆转化为实体齿轮进行交易的地方。雷昂意识到，自己那黄金般的脉动正是唤醒失落过去记录的关键，于是他毅然踏入了迷雾之城的深渊。
